title: Strong diffeomorphic approximation in three dimensions for p>2
main_claim: For bounded domains Omega, Lambda in R^3 and 2<p<infinity, every W^{1,p} homeomorphism f: Omega -> Lambda can be approximated strongly in W^{1,p} by C^infinity diffeomorphisms of Omega onto exactly Lambda. This resolves the fixed-target Ball-Evans problem in 3D for p>2.
coverage: This was a partial audit. The paper is about 10k lines of LaTeX, and I checked the load-bearing analytic steps rather than every line. Sec 1: main theorem and the local-tolerance lemma. Sec 5 (05-high-preparation.tex): I checked the regularity lemma, which covers Frechet differentiability via the sphere-oscillation/openness argument, the deficient-rank null image via the area formula, Lusin N for p>=3 via osc^3 <= C int|Du|^3, and null images of planar sections. I also checked the forbidden-cone lemma, where im Df lies in the decomposability bundle and the bundle is a proper subspace on f(D) by Alberti-Marchese Thm 1.1 together with the De Philippis-Rindler converse to Rademacher. Also checked: the Rainwater/Sion simultaneous graph-null lemma; the thin-band chain/antichain lemma (Lipschitz constants, n_w*w -> 0); the exceptional-box lemma; the regular-implant cost bound C|Db|^p R^3/det Db <= C int_{V_b}|DF|^p; and the statement of the two-round carrier. Sec 6: the polar-coordinate bounds, including a hand check of the rectangle estimates |Dt(v1)|=1/r and |Ds(v1)|<=gamma/r on end sectors. Sec 7: the crossing lower bound (structure), the spherical path estimate (geodesic/half-space argument, and the kernel 1/sin(theta) is in L^{p'} because p'<2), and the guard barrier, where the scaling sum gives at least c*a*h^{2-p}, which blows up because p>2. Sec 9 in full: capacity selection by Markov with A_j=2^{j+6}(1+B_j); the weak-cost charging; the sharp-count lemma; the rank-one/rank-two basis identities (BV=[I,0] and ||V^{-1}||=||B||, verified); the uniform-convexity inequality and its Hessian proof; the mean-gradient control by the boundary integral; the rank-one leading error, where |D0| in [1-C gamma, 1] shows why gamma enters; the physical conversion r||V^{-1}|| <= C|Df|; and the completion. That covers the p<3 marked-cube compression (inner alpha^{3-p} and outer int t^{2-p} bounds), global W^{1,p} membership and fixed-target surjectivity. Not verified line by line: the normal-surface/mesh machinery of Sec 8 (normalization, snapping, broadening, the sharp-island contract internals) and the routing/period-conservation propositions of Sec 7. In those parts I only checked that the stated contracts fit how they are used in Sec 9.
sibling_notes: The family 368 board hive:oai_math:review:fam:368 was empty when I checked, so no sibling reports were available. The intro says the companion paper (1<=p<=2) is not used here, and I found no dependence on it in the parts I read. I have posted my summary to the board.
